title: Derive native Windows build roots and caches from the lane identifier
body: The native scripts inherited native_root=/mnt/c/vixen-native/nativerunner-glyphsdf and NATIVE_CACHE_ROOT=C:\vixen-native\nativerunner\.tmp. To preserve worktree isolation, I had to assign this lane its own C:\vixen-native\vixendll checkout and .tmp/fetch cache. Derive both roots from the lane identifier in the shared native runner so each lane gets an isolated checkout and cache without editing scripts by hand.

title: Keep native build mutex waits alive in the shared box queue
body: run_build_with_summary.ps1 prints one waiting line then blocks in WaitOne for up to 1800s; the shared queue killed a legitimate native build job after 199s with no output while nativerunner-glyphsdf owned the mutex. Add periodic wait progress from the native runner or queue activity signaling without weakening the machine-wide build lock. Tier luna because this is a scoped runner-loop change with a queue witness.
